mapper.update: update fe_sdk_sync_log stale left join fe_sdk_sync_log terminal on terminal.dept_id = stale.dept_id and terminal.sync_log_id > stale.sync_log_id and terminal.sync_status in ('success', 'failed') set stale.sync_status = 'failed', stale.end_time = #{closeTime}, stale.fail_count = coalesce(stale.fail_count, 0) + 1, stale.message = left(concat_ws('; ', nullif(stale.message, ''), #{message}), 2000), stale.update_by = #{operator}, stale.update_time = #{closeTime} where stale.sync_status = 'running' and (coalesce(stale.update_time, stale.start_time) < #{cutoffTime} or terminal.sync_log_id is not null)
